body:
Source: GitHub issue #697 (release-audit class false-green, P1-high, tokenomics). Re-verified on main @ 7f45efd5: `packages/model-router/bin/model-router.mjs:21` validates `isNaN(floor) || floor < 0 || floor > 1`, so `--floor 0` is accepted. With floor 0, Rule 1b in lib/assign.mjs (`density < floor`) can never fire and the P3 filter in lib/router.mjs (`a.railDensity < floor`) can never match: the gate is a guaranteed exit 0 for every ticket set, and a ticket with ZERO rails is downgraded from `frontier` to whatever the priors say (observed `mid`). Nothing on stdout/stderr says the gate was disabled; the README documents the range as `<0-1>`.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/model-router`: bin/model-router.mjs (parseArgs/opError/gateFail/pass from @adlc/core; default floor 0.2), lib/router.mjs (`runRouter({ ticketsPath, floor })` → `{ assignments, p3Findings, ticketErrors, skippedLedger }`), lib/assign.mjs (`assignAll(tickets, cpmResult, priors, floor)`, rules 1/1b/2/3), lib/density.mjs, lib/priors.mjs, lib/format.mjs. Tests: test/model-router.test.mjs, test/active-tickets.test.mjs (`npm test -w packages/model-router`). Fixture stores can be a temp dir containing `.adlc/tickets.json` (legacy flat file) or `--tickets <path>` — look at how test/model-router.test.mjs builds its fixtures and reuse that helper style.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. The floor must satisfy `0 < floor <= 1`. Put the predicate in ONE exported validator in lib (suggested `assertFloor(floor)` in lib/router.mjs or a new lib/floor.mjs) that throws an Error whose message contains `--floor must be a number greater than 0 and at most 1` and explains why 0 is refused (`0 would disable the P3 rail-density gate: every ticket passes and unrailed tickets leave frontier`). The bin calls it and reports through opError (exit 1) with the flag's raw text in the message (`got: 0`). `-0`, `0.0`, `0`, negative, NaN and `> 1` are all rejected; the default 0.2 is unchanged.
2. Library callers cannot bypass it either: `runRouter({ floor: 0 })` rejects and `assignAll(..., 0)` throws via the same validator. Grep the repo for other callers of runRouter/assignAll or `--floor` (packages/fleet, packages/runner, plugins/*, docs) and make sure none passes 0; if one does, fix the caller in the same PR only if it is inside this ticket's scope — otherwise report it.
3. Documentation: update `packages/model-router/README.md` (flag table `--floor` row and the Exit Codes / P3 text) to say the accepted range is `(0, 1]` and that 0 is rejected because it would disable the gate; make the SAME edit by hand in the mirrors `docs/tools/model-router.md` and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/model-router.mdx` (hand-maintained — never regenerate).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 With a fixture holding one non-frontier-category ticket that has zero rails: `node packages/model-router/bin/model-router.mjs --floor 0 --tickets <fixture>` exits 1 and stderr matches /greater than 0/; the same for `--floor -0` and `--floor 0.0`; `--floor 1.5` and `--floor abc` still exit 1. verify: `node --test packages/model-router/test/floor-zero.test.mjs`
- AC2 Regression pin: the same fixture with `--floor 0.2` exits 2 with a P3 finding naming the ticket, and `--json` shows that ticket at tier `frontier`. verify: `node --test packages/model-router/test/floor-zero.test.mjs`
- AC3 `runRouter({ ticketsPath, floor: 0 })` rejects and `assignAll(tickets, cpm, priors, 0)` throws, both via the single exported validator (test the validator directly for 0, -0, 0.0000, -1, NaN, 1.0000001, and accepts 0.0001, 0.2, 1). verify: `node --test packages/model-router/test/floor-zero.test.mjs`
- AC4 Existing suite green (if an existing test uses floor 0 as a fixture value, update it and say so in the PR body). verify: `npm test -w packages/model-router`
- AC5 Docs updated in all three places. verify: `grep -c "greater than 0" packages/model-router/README.md docs/tools/model-router.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/model-router.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC6 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

PROCESS (ADLC). Work only in your assigned worktree. P3: the rails on this ticket are frozen — if the fix appears to require editing a rail path, STOP and report; never set ADLC_RAILS_BYPASS. P4: TDD — write test/floor-zero.test.mjs first, run it RED, then implement. P5 before opening the PR: `npm test -w packages/model-router`, `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` (exit 0), then `npx adversarial-review --base origin/main --provider codex --timeout 600` and loop review→fix→re-review until exit 0 with ZERO findings and no warning lines (read findings[] every round; exit 0 alone is not the signal). Do not add gate-manifest entries. Keep the diff to packages/model-router/**, the three docs files, and this ticket's shard. PR title `fix(model-router): ...`, body must contain `Closes #697`.
title: model-router: reject --floor 0 — it silently disables the P3 rail-density gate and routes unrailed tickets off frontier
